step1_analysis.description: A complementary cross-coupled CMOS pair that provides negative resistance to sustain oscillation in an LC tank. It forms the active core of an LC-VCO.

paper_reference.title: MOS Varactors With n- and p-Type Gates and Their Influence on an LC-VCO in Digital CMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)) with L=4.5nH and C=3.3pF
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the LC tank values chosen to match the paper's reported frequency.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise at a specific offset frequency (e.g., 1 MHz)

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on tank Q and active device noise
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported value assuming similar tank Q.

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of the oscillator core

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_dc. With VDD=1.8V and I_dc ~ 0.22mA for the given W/L
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the self-biased DC operating point of the cross-coupled pair with W=5u, L=0.5u.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on tank parallel resistance and bias current
sky130_expected.reasoning: The swing is limited by the supply voltage (1.8V) and the tank losses.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure oscillation frequency, voltage swing, and power consumption of the LC-VCO core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC-VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 QX Q VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 Q QX VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 Q QX VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 QX Q VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0

* LC Tank (Added to complete the VCO for testing)
L1 Q QX 4.5n
C1 Q QX 3.3p
R1 Q QX 5000

* Startup kick to initiate oscillation
I_kick Q QX pulse(0 1m 1n 100p 100p 1n 50n)

.control
tran 10p 50n

* Measure frequency (using 0.7V as it is near the self-biased DC point)
meas tran t_start trig v(Q) val=0.7 rise=20
meas tran t_end trig v(Q) val=0.7 rise=25
let f_osc = 5 / (t_end - t_start)
print f_osc

* Measure peak-to-peak voltage swing
meas tran v_max max v(Q) from=30n to=50n
meas tran v_min min v(Q) from=30n to=50n
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

* Measure DC power consumption
meas tran i_vdd avg i(VVDD) from=30n to=50n
let p_dc = -i_vdd * 1.8
print p_dc

quit
.endc
.end
